unmapped_findings: The 17Al alloy chemical composition (EDS, Table 1) is Fe 43.2, Mn 34.8, Al 17.0, Cu 5.0 (at.%).
The density of the 17Al alloy measured by the Archimedes method is 6.76 g/cm³.
The solution-treated (parent state) baseline Vickers hardness of the 17Al alloy is 259.8 ± 1.5 HV.
For the 17Al alloy the α→β-Mn transformation was completed after 6 h at 550 °C, but only after 1 h at 600 °C and above.

Increasing Al content slowed the precipitation kinetics of β-Mn and decreased the fracture toughness of the ultra-hard alloys; the intrinsic hardness of β-Mn was slightly enhanced by higher Al (solid-solution strengthening).
The elastic modulus of the 17Al alloy measured through compressive stress-strain curves was 175 GPa.
